server.description: 22 web-data tools: search, Bing, images, Reddit without authors, jobs, patents, flights and YouTube.
server.title: FastAF

authentication.instructions: Connect with MCP OAuth and authorize using an existing FastAF API key. Direct Authorization: Bearer API-key and X-API-Key remain supported. OAuth is discovered at runtime; no static header is required in the client configuration.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.signup: Get a free API key at https://fastaf.co/signup/ with an email address, terms acceptance and browser verification. No card is required. POST /public/signup automatically creates the first API key and emails it with a confirmation link. It sets a dashboard session cookie but does not return an API key in the response. Save the key from the welcome email and follow the emailed GET /public/signin/{token} link before making data calls. FastAF stores only the key hash and cannot show or resend that key. After email confirmation, create additional or replacement keys in the dashboard (POST /v1/keys with the session cookie); those keys are shown only once. Email confirmation unlocks 500 free credits every month per account, shared across all keys and all REST/MCP endpoints and used before any paid credits. They reset to 500 at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month and do not carry over; they are not valid on x402. Failed calls use no credits. Unverified accounts receive email_verification_required (403) before any data call or credit reservation. Signups are limited per IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /64 network per UTC day (default 3); 429 means retry after the reset. GET /v1/usage reports free_credits_remaining and free_credits_reset_at separately from balance_credits. POST /v1/signup is retired and returns 410 signup_disabled. Prepaid credit packs: Starter $10 for 20,000 credits; Growth $29 for 75,000; Scale $99 for 300,000; Pro $299 for 1,000,000; Business $799 for 3,000,000. All packs are valid 12 months. Agents without an inbox can use /x402/v1/{endpoint} without an account, with x402 pay-per-call from $0.003.
